faq.question: How much does window replacement cost in Belmont?
faq.answer: Belmont homeowners typically invest $6,500 to $14,000 for a full window replacement project covering 10–15 windows. Belmont Hills properties with larger windows and custom configurations will see costs at the higher end of that range. Single window installations start around $550–$650.

faq.question: Do I need a permit to replace windows in Belmont?
faq.answer: Yes. Belmont requires a building permit for window replacement projects, particularly those involving changes to rough opening size or framing. Like-for-like replacements may qualify for a streamlined permit process. Our team handles all Belmont permit applications on your behalf.

faq.question: Is it worth replacing 20-year-old windows in Belmont?
faq.answer: Often yes. Twenty-year-old windows in Belmont commonly show fogged glass, drafts and weak locks. Newer ENERGY STAR units improve comfort and curb appeal; Deluxe Windows compares payback against your utility rates and home style before recommending replacement.

faq.question: Should I choose fiberglass or vinyl windows in Belmont?
faq.answer: Vinyl is the value pick for most Belmont replacements and handles Bay Area weather well. Fiberglass (including Marvin Ultrex) is stronger, more stable in temperature swings and better for larger openings or coastal exposure. We show both side by side in the showroom and on-site.

faq.question: How long does window replacement take in Belmont?
faq.answer: Most Belmont projects are measured in one visit and installed in one to three working days once products arrive — typically four to eight weeks after ordering, depending on brand and custom sizes.
